facts.fact: The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications told the Council of Ministers that 7,000 km of fibre is currently deployed, to reach over 18,500 km once 11,500 km more is added under the Digital Transformation Project begun a year earlier; the document does not name regions or say the fibre is lit, so the article date is used.

systems.system: Projet de transformation numerique (PTN) fibre deployment
systems.owner: Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications / Government of DRC

note: In-service rests on 'deployed' only; no places named. Works under way on the 11,500 km not stated, so no building fact.
